objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled information object that goes through creation, editing, review, release, and archiving lifecycle stages.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction)

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document (Editing, Review, Released, Out of Force, Archived)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Expiration date for the document's validity

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or subject of the document

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual text and information contained in the document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is automatically released with its main document and triggers versioning of the parent document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state matching the parent document's release status

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number linked to parent document version

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document that does not follow the main document's release cycle and can be independently released or deleted.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to an existing document that does not affect the document's version history until implemented.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Pending, Scheduled, or Completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review whether a document should remain valid, be revised, or be invalidated.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Pending or Completed

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Pending or Completed

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document and restore it to active status.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Pending or Completed

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual who participates in document management processes with assigned roles and permissions.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Assigned function such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator

attributes.name: authorization
attributes.description: Specific read and write permissions on documents

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned together for authorization and distribution purposes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, or Business Admin

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: An assignment of users or user groups to be notified about or acknowledge specific documents.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Email notification or Acknowledgement requirement

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document object with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification selected for the new document

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the text, data, or information contained within a document using local Office components.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format such as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Set or update metadata and attributes of a document such as scope, references, and authorization assignments.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Grouped set of related properties being maintained

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read or write permissions to users or user groups for a document.

attributes.name: permission_type
attributes.description: Read or write access level

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start the formal approval workflow for a document by the author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically sign a document during a workflow step to confirm completion of author, review, or release responsibilities.

attributes.name: signature_type
attributes.description: Whether signature is for creation, review, or release

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Examine document content for technical and formal compliance as assigned reviewer.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: Authorize the release and distribution of a document to readers as the releaser.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Return a document from review or release workflow due to identified issues.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically make a released document visible to assigned readers after approval.

evts.name: acknowledge_document
evts.description: Confirm receipt and understanding of a distributed document through workflow.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a suggested modification to a document without affecting its current version or release status.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Apply a scheduled change proposal to a document, creating a new version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled supplementary document to a main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as no longer relevant, to be physically archived with the next main document version release.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Add an uncontrolled supplementary item to a document for informational purposes.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Remove an additional information item from a document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Generate a system request to review document validity before expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approve and extend the validity period of a document by updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate the process to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force and archive it with revoked authorizations.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate restoration of a previously invalidated and archived document to active status.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate an archived document and create a new version with restored authorizations.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Examine translated content for accuracy and completeness.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Authorize the release of a translated document version to readers.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign or modify users and user groups to receive notifications or acknowledgements for a document.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Email notification or Acknowledgement requirement

evts.name: send_notification
evts.description: Automatically deliver email to recipients about document release or workflow tasks.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Release notification or workflow task notification

evts.name: restrict_document_visibility
evts.description: Limit document visibility to specified client systems in a multi-client environment.

attributes.name: client_scope
attributes.description: Which clients the document is visible in

o2o.description: A document may have attachments that are controlled and versioned together with it.
A document may have additional information items that are independent of its release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to and references a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to a document requiring validity review.
An override request references the document being invalidated.
A reactivation request references the previously archived document being restored.
Documents may reference other documents through maintained reference attributes.
Documents are assigned to user groups through distribution lists and authorization attributes.
Users are members of user groups that determine their collective permissions and distribution assignments.
